_comment: The answer this fixture exists to pin: what the binaries a build produced
say about the components an SBOM declares. Hand-authored, deliberately not
machine-blessed -- a correctness fixture that regenerates itself from the
code under test proves nothing. Derive each number from trace.jsonl and
scripts/run_binscan_case.py's generator by hand before changing it.
The trace names five things bomwerk can open:
build/app          linked output, DT_NEEDED libvendcrypto.so.1 + libc.so.6
build/tool-static  linked output, statically linked: no dynamic section
build/libzlib.a    written by the ar record
.../libvendcrypto.a   a prebuilt vendored archive, consumed on a link line
.../libvendcrypto.so.1 a prebuilt vendored shared object, likewise
The cc record is a COMPILE, so its `-o ...adler32.c.o` is not a link output;
a relocatable has nothing the binary pass could read anyway.
vendored-crypto gains THREE pieces of evidence, on different proof:
- build/app declares DT_NEEDED libvendcrypto.so.1, and a file answering to
that soname exists under the component root (the existence check is what
separates evidence from a name-shaped guess),
- libvendcrypto.a lies inside the component and holds 2 members,
- libvendcrypto.so.1 lies inside the component too: a prebuilt shared
object under a component root IS that component, exactly as an archive is.
zlib has sources but no binary, so the pass says nothing about it. left-pad
records no location at all, so nothing can attribute to it.
libc.so.6 resolves to no file in this repository. It is REPORTED, never
emitted as a component and never warned about: a system library missing from
your SBOM is the normal case, and warning on it would make the warning
channel useless on the first real run.
Exit 1, not 0, and that is the point: build/tool-static is statically linked,
which is a degraded read of the product's dynamic dependencies even though
nothing went wrong. Exit 0 from binscan means every artifact was read AND
understood.

pkg:generic/vendored-crypto@1.0.0: binary: 2 archive member(s) under third_party/vendored-crypto (e.g. aes.o)
binary: DT_NEEDED libvendcrypto.so.1 resolves under third_party/vendored-crypto (declared by build/app)
binary: 1 prebuilt shared object(s) under third_party/vendored-crypto (e.g. third_party/vendored-crypto/libvendcrypto.so.1)
